THE OPERATING PRINCIPLES

01

Define good.
Then measure it.

Service objectives should reflect user experience. Error budgets make the tradeoff between reliability and delivery explicit.

02

Build the paved road.
Keep the exits.

Useful defaults, clear ownership and room for informed choices. Developer experience is an engineering outcome.

03

Delegate the toil.
Keep accountability.

AI connects evidence and proposes actions. Autonomy should follow risk, with observable decisions and reversible changes.
